scope: Only v3, frozen task, and independent critic probes. No generated baseline/candidate was read or executed. No suite edits.

original_findings.closed: T03/T05/T10/T12 no longer reject user-triggered safe replay merely for submitting twice or canSubmit=true. Guarded safe replay passes 14/14.
original_findings.remaining: T04 line45 still requires total submit calls==1. An immediate bounded retry inside confirm reuses the identical immutable payload/ID, preserves effects==1, but fails only T04 (13/14).
original_findings.fix: Record submit count immediately before check; require check adds no new mutation, and verify same intent/effect count. Do not assume confirm made exactly one network attempt.

original_findings.evidence: Wrong bookingId is rejected by T01; wrong cancellation ID by T06. The wrong-ID probe now fails both.
original_findings.limits: These are selected-path assertions; not exhaustive identity/authorization or real-service validation.

original_findings.evidence: Original race-prone probe fails T13 and T14; guarded counterpart passes 14/14. Both late acknowledgement and late transport-error overwrite are now detected.
original_findings.limits: Other stale lookup/new-operation races remain untested. T13/T14 assume concurrent check is available; see C05.

original_findings.evidence: False-message probe still passes 14/14. This is expected for a controller-only oracle.
original_findings.required_action: Independently inspect actual implementation/rendered text for unknown/pending/success/failure/cancellation, and retain evidence. Do not close this finding based on v3 score or nonempty message fields.

defects.symptom: Automatic same-ID/same-payload safe replay before reconciliation remains falsely rejected.
evidence: probe_auto_replay.mjs wraps only submit to retry once immediately on a transport exception.
The task explicitly deduplicates the same request ID and identical payload for 24 hours.
defects.impact: Valid bounded retry policies are still penalized in the campaign score.
defects.fix: Assert no additional submission during check by comparing before/after counts; verify prior attempts are the same intent and one backend effect.

defects.symptom: New race trials require check to run concurrently with an unresolved cancellation even when view().canCheck is false.
evidence: task.md specifies available methods and view flags but does not require simultaneous check/cancel execution.
probe_serialized_cancel.mjs honestly disables canCheck/canCancel while cancel awaits a response and restores check afterwards.
v3-serialized-cancel.json: 12/14; only T13/T14 fail at the intermediate success assertion before the cancellation response is released.
The same serialized implementation passes every original sequential path and retains result reconciliation after acknowledgement.
defects.impact: A valid serialization design is misclassified as a stale-response defect. Additional concurrency complexity becomes an unstated acceptance requirement.
defects.fix: Condition race branch on whether concurrent check is available. If unavailable, release/reject cancel, await it, then check and require verified completion. If available, retain late-response ordering and final-state preservation assertions. Any pending promises must be released even when assertions fail.

copy_truthfulness: Requires separate actual implementation and rendered-DOM inspection; deliberately false text passes this suite. No such inspection occurred in this recheck.
limitations: This is a same-model separate context, not objective or model-independent validation.
Probes are controller-only negative controls, not complete index.html deliverables.
C02/C03 closure is limited to the reproduced oracle defects, not all possible identity and race cases.
No generated implementation or score was read.
No public/test mutations; added and changed probes only under private/B/round01/critic.
Parent was informed of residual C01 and new C05 before this report.
